title: Levites and Firstborn

questions.question: Who were the sons of Aaron?
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:2 (ESV): "These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar."

questions.question: What happened to Nadab and Abihu?
options: They died before the Lord when they offered unauthorized fire
questions.correctAnswer: They died before the Lord when they offered unauthorized fire
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:4 (ESV): "But Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord when they offered unauthorized fire..."

questions.question: Who was given to Aaron and his sons to assist them?
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:6-7 (ESV): "Bring the tribe of Levi near... to minister to him."

questions.question: The Levites were taken in place of whom?
options: All the firstborn among the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: All the firstborn among the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:12 (ESV): "Behold, I have taken the Levites... instead of every firstborn who opens the womb..."

questions.question: Who camped in front of the tabernacle on the east?
options: Moses and Aaron and his sons
questions.correctAnswer: Moses and Aaron and his sons
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:38 (ESV): "Those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east... were Moses and Aaron and his sons."

questions.question: What was the specific duty of the Gershonites?
options: The tabernacle, the tent, the covering, the screen
questions.correctAnswer: The tabernacle, the tent, the covering, the screen
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:25 (ESV): "The guard duty... involved the tabernacle, the tent with its covering, the screen..."

questions.question: What was the duty of the Kohathites?
options: The sanctuary vessels (ark, table, lampstand, altars)
questions.correctAnswer: The sanctuary vessels (ark, table, lampstand, altars)
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:31 (ESV): "Their guard duty involved the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars..."

questions.question: What was the duty of the Merarites?
options: The frames, bars, pillars, and bases
questions.correctAnswer: The frames, bars, pillars, and bases
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:36 (ESV): "The appointed guard duty... involved the frames of the tabernacle, the bars, the pillars, the bases..."

questions.question: What was total number of Levites aged one month and upward?
How many firstborn males of Israel were there?
Since the firstborn outnumbered the Levites by 273, what was done?
options: Redemption money (5 shekels each) was paid
questions.correctAnswer: Redemption money (5 shekels each) was paid
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:46-47 (ESV): "And for the redemption of the 273... you shall take five shekels per head."

questions.question: Who was the chief of the leaders of the Levites?
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:32 (ESV): "Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was to be chief over the chiefs of the Levites."

questions.question: Where did the Kohathites camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:29 (ESV): "The clans of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side."

questions.question: Where did the Gershonites camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:23 (ESV): "The clans of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle on the west."

questions.question: Where did the Merarites camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 3:35 (ESV): "They were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle."

key_verse_text: Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the people of Israel instead of every firstborn who opens the womb among the people of Israel. The Levites shall be mine.
